info.title: Law offices, jobs and pay by county, with solo-practice counts: BLS QCEW, Census CBP and Nonemployer Statistics: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Law offices, jobs and pay by county, with solo-practice counts: BLS QCEW, Census CBP and Nonemployer Statistics: Private offices of lawyers (NAICS 541110) in every U.S. county, every state and the nation. For each area: establishments, March employment and average weekly pay from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (the latest quarter, with the seven before it); employer offices from the Census Bureau's County Business Patterns 2023 exactly as first published; firms with no employees in legal services from Nonemployer Statistics 2024; and the 2025 Census population estimate, so each area has offices and solo firms per 10,000 residents. Where BLS suppresses a county's employment or pay the value is empty and flagged, never filled in. An office is an establishment, not a lawyer.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
